name: LVIS: A Dataset for Large Vocabulary Instance Segmentation
description: LVIS is a large-vocabulary instance segmentation benchmark designed to evaluate recognition and segmentation performance on many rare and long-tail object categories.
evaluation_method: Mask Average Precision (mask AP) and box AP, with emphasis on rare-category performance and long-tail evaluation.
typical_sota_score: Moderate to strong on frequent classes, but overall performance is constrained by many rare categories and long-tail imbalance.
notes: LVIS is especially important for measuring robustness beyond common categories. It is more challenging than COCO-style evaluation because of the long-tail distribution.
